mapping_basis: Paper uses VL1/VL2 for OA-VL1/OA-VL2 (synonyms.csv: DNd02/DNd03); 'VL neurons' covers both, and the Fig. 6B line and which VL subtypes it labels are not stated in the available text, so DNd02 is assigned only by the sibling convention (k=1).
n_flies_note: number of pairs given only in Fig. 6B (not available locally)
notes: Readout is lunge rate (aggression), not leg movement; aggression was not decreased. The Fig. 6/Table S1/Table S4 images and files were not available, so the line ID and its VL1/VL2 coverage cannot be verified. This experiment may not meet the section 1 requirement that leg movement be observable.
quote: Optogenetic activation of VL neurons and ASM1–3 neurons did not decrease aggression relative to genetic controls except OTA-SG05 (Figure 6B).

stimulation: 655 nm red light, 10 ms pulses at 5 Hz, intensity 12μM/cm2 (as printed)
title: Cellular and functional dissection of the octopaminergic and tyraminergic system in the Drosophila brain.
